description.value: Friendly private RV park right off Highway 3 on the Similkameen River, with shaded grassed sites, a sandy beach for swimming and tubing, flush showers, and coin laundry; primarily hook-up-oriented and open April 15 to Thanksgiving.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record; phone (250) 292-8221 and email reservations@riverhavenrv.com are extracted from the website since OSM lists no phone. Amenity claims are drawn from the website amenities page: coin showers, coin laundry, full-service water hookups, free high-speed internet, and an onsite camp store are all explicitly stated. No hiker/biker-specific sites, tent camping, or cyclist-specific services are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Riverhaven RV Park' but the website consistently uses 'Riverhaven RV Park and Motel' — the motel component is absent from the OSM record.
No phone number in OSM tags; phone (250) 292-8221 sourced from website only.
Park is primarily marketed as an RV park; no explicit mention of tent sites or hiker/biker-specific accommodation — suitability for non-motorized camping is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operated campground on Hwy 3 (Crowsnest Pass), a major cycle-touring corridor, with confirmed showers, laundry, free internet, and river access — all high-value amenities for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free high-speed internet confirmed on website. Pets welcome in the RV park with leash requirement; no pets permitted in motel rooms.

wow_evidence: sandy beach for swimming and tubing, flush showers, and coin laundry
